object.customQuery:
SELECT XT_HOSPITAL_PACK.XC_HOSPITAL_PACKAGE_RK as XC_HOSPITAL_PACKAGE_RK, XT_HOSPITAL_PACK.XC_VALID_FROM_DTTM as XC_VALID_FROM_DTTM, XT_HOSPITAL_PACK.HASH_VALUE as HASH_VALUE, XT_HOSPITAL_PACK.XC_HOSPITAL_PACKAGE_ID as XC_HOSPITAL_PACKAGE_ID, XT_HOSPITAL_PACK.XC_SCHEMA_TYPE_ID as XC_SCHEMA_TYPE_ID, XT_HOSPITAL_PACK.XC_SOURCE_SYSTEM_ID as XC_SOURCE_SYSTEM_ID

 WHERE XC_HOSPITAL_PACKAGE_ID IN (SELECT XC_HOSPITAL_PACKAGE_ID FROM IDM.TEMP_SQ_SCT_VXT_HOSPITAL_PACK ) 
AND    XC_SOURCE_SYSTEM_ID IN (SELECT XC_SOURCE_SYSTEM_ID FROM IDM.TEMP_SQ_SCT_VXT_HOSPITAL_PACK)

object.customQuery:
SELECT XC_DISCOUNT_AMT,
       XC_HOSPITAL_RK_XC_HOSPITAL_ID,
       XC_PACKAGE_EFFECTIVE_FROM_DT,
       XC_PACKAGE_EFFECTIVE_TO_DT,
       XC_PACKAGE_RT,
       XC_PACKAGE_TYPE,
       XC_SOURCE_SYSTEM_ID,
       XC_SCHEMA_TYPE_ID,
       XC_HOSPITAL_PACKAGE_ID,
       SRC_TAB_XC_HOSPITAL_RK,
       SRC_COL_XC_HOSPITAL_RK,
       SRC_PK_XC_HOSPITAL_RK,
       SRC_TAB_XC_HOSPITAL_PACKAGE_ID,               
	SRC_COL_XC_HOSPITAL_PACKAGE_ID,               
	SRC_PK_XC_HOSPITAL_PACKAGE_ID, 		
       MODIFIED_TIMESTAMP,
       DATA_MANIPULATION_TYPE,
	HASH_VALUE,
       DRIVING_TABLE_NAME,
       DRIVING_TAB_PK_COL_NAME,
       DRIVING_TAB_PK_VALUE,
	TARGET_TABLE_NAME,
	RECON_DESC_SUM_COL,
	RECON_SUM_COL_NAME

FROM (SELECT VXT_HOSPITAL_PACK_FTHTH.XC_DISCOUNT_AMT,
       VXT_HOSPITAL_PACK_FTHTH.XC_HOSPITAL_RK_XC_HOSPITAL_ID,
       VXT_HOSPITAL_PACK_FTHTH.XC_PACKAGE_EFFECTIVE_FROM_DT,
       VXT_HOSPITAL_PACK_FTHTH.XC_PACKAGE_EFFECTIVE_TO_DT,
       VXT_HOSPITAL_PACK_FTHTH.XC_PACKAGE_RT,
       VXT_HOSPITAL_PACK_FTHTH.XC_PACKAGE_TYPE,
       VXT_HOSPITAL_PACK_FTHTH.XC_SOURCE_SYSTEM_ID,
       VXT_HOSPITAL_PACK_FTHTH.XC_SCHEMA_TYPE_ID,
       VXT_HOSPITAL_PACK_FTHTH.XC_HOSPITAL_PACKAGE_ID,
       VXT_HOSPITAL_PACK_FTHTH.SRC_TAB_XC_HOSPITAL_RK,
       VXT_HOSPITAL_PACK_FTHTH.SRC_COL_XC_HOSPITAL_RK,
       VXT_HOSPITAL_PACK_FTHTH.SRC_PK_XC_HOSPITAL_RK,
       VXT_HOSPITAL_PACK_FTHTH.SRC_TAB_XC_HOSPITAL_PACKAGE_ID,               VXT_HOSPITAL_PACK_FTHTH.SRC_COL_XC_HOSPITAL_PACKAGE_ID,               VXT_HOSPITAL_PACK_FTHTH.SRC_PK_XC_HOSPITAL_PACKAGE_ID, 		
       VXT_HOSPITAL_PACK_FTHTH.MODIFIED_TIMESTAMP,
       VXT_HOSPITAL_PACK_FTHTH.DATA_MANIPULATION_TYPE,
       ORA_HASH(XC_DISCOUNT_AMT||XC_HOSPITAL_RK_XC_HOSPITAL_ID||XC_PACKAGE_EFFECTIVE_FROM_DT||XC_PACKAGE_EFFECTIVE_TO_DT||XC_PACKAGE_RT||XC_PACKAGE_TYPE||XC_HOSPITAL_PACKAGE_ID||DATA_MANIPULATION_TYPE||VXT_HOSPITAL_PACK_FTHTH.XC_SOURCE_SYSTEM_ID||XC_SCHEMA_TYPE_ID) AS HASH_VALUE,
       VXT_HOSPITAL_PACK_FTHTH.DRIVING_TABLE_NAME,
       VXT_HOSPITAL_PACK_FTHTH.DRIVING_TAB_PK_COL_NAME,
       VXT_HOSPITAL_PACK_FTHTH.DRIVING_TAB_PK_VALUE,
'XT_HOSPITAL_PACK' as TARGET_TABLE_NAME,
'SUM OF XC_DISCOUNT_AMT' AS RECON_DESC_SUM_COL,
'XC_DISCOUNT_AMT' AS RECON_SUM_COL_NAME
FROM 
$$SRC_SCHEMA.$$SRC_VIEW  VXT_HOSPITAL_PACK_FTHTH
WHERE 
TRUNC(MODIFIED_TIMESTAMP) >=TRUNC(TO_DATE('$$PREV_EXEC_END_DATE','MM/DD/YYYY HH:MI:SS AM')) and
TRUNC(MODIFIED_TIMESTAMP)<TRUNC(TO_DATE('$$CURR_EXEC_START_DATE','MM/DD/YYYY HH:MI:SS AM'))

UNION ALL

SELECT VXT_HOSPITAL_PACK_FTHTH.XC_DISCOUNT_AMT,
       VXT_HOSPITAL_PACK_FTHTH.XC_HOSPITAL_RK_XC_HOSPITAL_ID,
       VXT_HOSPITAL_PACK_FTHTH.XC_PACKAGE_EFFECTIVE_FROM_DT,
       VXT_HOSPITAL_PACK_FTHTH.XC_PACKAGE_EFFECTIVE_TO_DT,
       VXT_HOSPITAL_PACK_FTHTH.XC_PACKAGE_RT,
       VXT_HOSPITAL_PACK_FTHTH.XC_PACKAGE_TYPE,
       VXT_HOSPITAL_PACK_FTHTH.XC_SOURCE_SYSTEM_ID,
       VXT_HOSPITAL_PACK_FTHTH.XC_SCHEMA_TYPE_ID,
       VXT_HOSPITAL_PACK_FTHTH.XC_HOSPITAL_PACKAGE_ID,
       VXT_HOSPITAL_PACK_FTHTH.SRC_TAB_XC_HOSPITAL_RK,
       VXT_HOSPITAL_PACK_FTHTH.SRC_COL_XC_HOSPITAL_RK,
       VXT_HOSPITAL_PACK_FTHTH.SRC_PK_XC_HOSPITAL_RK,
       VXT_HOSPITAL_PACK_FTHTH.SRC_TAB_XC_HOSPITAL_PACKAGE_ID,               VXT_HOSPITAL_PACK_FTHTH.SRC_COL_XC_HOSPITAL_PACKAGE_ID,               VXT_HOSPITAL_PACK_FTHTH.SRC_PK_XC_HOSPITAL_PACKAGE_ID, 		
       VXT_HOSPITAL_PACK_FTHTH.MODIFIED_TIMESTAMP,
       VXT_HOSPITAL_PACK_FTHTH.DATA_MANIPULATION_TYPE,
       ORA_HASH(XC_DISCOUNT_AMT||XC_HOSPITAL_RK_XC_HOSPITAL_ID||XC_PACKAGE_EFFECTIVE_FROM_DT||XC_PACKAGE_EFFECTIVE_TO_DT||XC_PACKAGE_RT||XC_PACKAGE_TYPE||XC_HOSPITAL_PACKAGE_ID||DATA_MANIPULATION_TYPE||VXT_HOSPITAL_PACK_FTHTH.XC_SOURCE_SYSTEM_ID||XC_SCHEMA_TYPE_ID) AS HASH_VALUE,
       VXT_HOSPITAL_PACK_FTHTH.DRIVING_TABLE_NAME,
       VXT_HOSPITAL_PACK_FTHTH.DRIVING_TAB_PK_COL_NAME,
       VXT_HOSPITAL_PACK_FTHTH.DRIVING_TAB_PK_VALUE,
'XT_HOSPITAL_PACK' as TARGET_TABLE_NAME,
'SUM OF XC_DISCOUNT_AMT' AS RECON_DESC_SUM_COL,
'XC_DISCOUNT_AMT' AS RECON_SUM_COL_NAME
FROM 
$$SRC_SCHEMA.$$SRC_VIEW  VXT_HOSPITAL_PACK_FTHTH,

(select distinct driving_tab_pk_value ,feed_id from ODS_PFD_INS.EDW_ERROR_REPROCESS where  UPPER(FEED_ID)= Upper('$$SRC_VIEW')) A
WHERE 
 VXT_HOSPITAL_PACK_FTHTH.DRIVING_TAB_PK_VALUE = A.DRIVING_TAB_PK_VALUE

)

ORDER BY XC_HOSPITAL_PACKAGE_ID,MODIFIED_TIMESTAMP
